tasks.task_name: 执行月度/季度业绩数据汇总
tasks.tier_rationale: 单一数据汇总动作，信息处理类，明确规则，D1-D6均为2，具备完全自动化条件（EVD-40eef74d4a4ecff5cd32）。
月度业绩报表生成依赖动态业务口径，D2规则清晰度评分为1，需人工确认模板与规则，建议Hybrid。
Activity rate analysis requires interpretation of customer behavior; rule clarity D2=1, touchpoint is manual execution (EVD-89816f3238b0ab9475b8), suggesting Human tier.
Conversion tracking requires business judgment, similar to activity rate analysis, human execution touchpoint, Human tier.

tasks.task_name: 撰写季度分公司经营分析报告
tasks.tier_rationale: Quarterly analysis requires human judgment but can be assisted by AI data insights; Skill feasibility grade C, suggested Hybrid with Agent support.
Final review requires professional judgment and authority; human touchpoint mandates manual execution (EVD-089039df868466b49541).
Submission can be automated via system, but requires human confirmation for compliance; Hybrid tier.
